message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 25 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 26 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (27 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, normalized and deduplicated, plus the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

New advisories relevant to psqlODBC and Ubuntu were found, along with a new exploitation report for a previously disclosed Nginx issue. Some advisories give a publication date but no time, so their precise placement within the 24-hour window cannot be confirmed. Older underlying CVEs are identified as such.

**PostgreSQL psqlODBC: CVE-2026-136502 and related issues**
**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 8.1 for CVE-2026-136502. The driver can interpret SQL differently from the server, potentially allowing SQL injection or redirected writes under specific conditions. Versions through 18.00.0006 are affected; the maintainer lists 18.00.0007 as fixed. psqlODBC is explicitly monitored. A November 26 Canadian advisory also reports memory corruption and crashes in the driver; an Italian CSIRT alert lists 10 high-severity CVEs. These are separate issues in the same component, not duplicate CVEs. [Maintainer advisory](https://github.com/postgresql-interfaces/psqlodbc/security/advisories/GHSA-4392-6j85-5q2q), [Canadian advisory](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/postgresql-security-advisory-av26-1211), [CSIRT-ITA alert](https://365trust.me/rilevate-vulnerabilita-in-postgresql-psqlodbc-al03-261126-csirt-ita/).

**Nginx: CVE-2026-123007**
**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 8.1; Critical, CVSS 4.0 9.2 as reported by security researchers. This previously disclosed HTTP/2 memory corruption flaw can crash a worker and, under certain conditions, enable code execution. A November 26 report cites Singapore's cyber security agency as reporting active exploitation; the original fix was published November 18, so this is a new exploitation development, not a new CVE. Nginx is explicitly monitored. [Exploitation update and vendor details](https://www.rescana.com/post/f5-nginx-http2-cve-2026-123007-patch-now), [Cisco advisory](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/csa/cisco-sa-nginx-nov-2026-e8jska2s.html).

**Ubuntu Plexus Utils: CVE-2025-67030 (USN-9211-1)**
**Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice. A crafted archive could cause files to be overwritten or programs to run as the user's account. Canonical's November 26 notice covers Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04, 26.04 and 26.10 packages; the underlying CVE is older. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9211-1).

**Ubuntu ALSA library: CVE-2026-90781 and CVE-2026-96674 (USN-9208-1)**
**Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice. Crafted topology files or control identifiers may cause denial of service or expose sensitive information. Canonical issued fixes for Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 LTS. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9208-1).

**Ubuntu Apache Commons BCEL: CVE-2026-94114 (USN-9207-1)**
**Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice. Incorrect class-name handling may cause a different class to be returned or verified. Ubuntu packages for 22.04, 24.04, 26.04 and 26.10 are covered; fixes for the LTS releases listed require Ubuntu Pro ESM Apps. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9207-1).

**Ubuntu Guava: CVE-2020-8908, CVE-2023-2976 and CVE-2026-102554 (USN-9206-1)**
**Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice. Temporary-directory permission issues could expose or modify information, while crafted serialized data could cause denial of service. The notice covers Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 LTS; applicability differs by CVE and the listed fixes require Ubuntu Pro ESM Apps. The first two CVEs are older. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9206-1).

**MongoDB sweep:** Searches covered Server and mongod/mongos, Atlas and services, Ops Manager and Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, integrations and MongoDB-assigned advisories. No verified new issue or material development within this window was identified in the available results. The C Driver CVE-2026-135224 was published before this window and is not repeated as new. Search indexing and date-only source timestamps limit completeness.

**Closing:** Promptly review Nginx exposure and deployed psqlODBC versions, then assess the Ubuntu notices against installed packages and release versions.
